title: Two-dimensional galaxy cluster shapes using lensing data: a simulated analysis
comment: submitted to A&A, 16 pages, 9 figures; comments are welcome
summary: Context. Cluster morphology reflects assembly history and dynamical state. High-resolution weak lensing can reveal departures from spherical symmetry, but its ability to recover two-dimensional shapes remains less explored. Aims. We assess how reliably weak lensing recovers projected cluster morphology and its dependence on orientation and dynamical state. We also compare large-scale weak-lensing morphology with that traced by strong lensing near the cluster centre. Methods. We study three clusters at $z=0.22$ from The Three Hundred Project, representing relaxed, mildly disturbed and unrelaxed systems. For each, we consider three random projections and three along the principal axes of the mass tensor. For each projection, we generate 128 weak-lensing catalogues with a source density of 30 arcmin$^{-2}$ and intrinsic ellipticity dispersion $σ_ε=0.3$. We constrain mass and concentration from one-dimensional NFW and BMO fits, then recover ellipticity, position angle and centre using a two-dimensional elliptical NFW model. We also measure morphology from true convergence maps, Kaiser \& Squires reconstructions and strong-lensing tangential critical lines. Results. Recovered parameters depend on orientation and dynamical state. The relaxed cluster has similar inner and large-scale shapes, whereas disturbed systems appear more elliptical centrally. Two-dimensional weak-lensing modelling recovers the projected mass orientation despite source sampling and shape noise. Kaiser \& Squires reconstructions recover the position angle well but favour rounder mass distributions. Centroid offsets are larger in unrelaxed systems. Conclusions. Combining weak- and strong-lensing morphology probes cluster structure across physical scales and offers a promising way to investigate morphology and dynamical state.

title: Constraining the Inner Dark Matter Profiles of Strong-Lensing Galaxy Clusters
summary: We present mass modeling of three strong lensing galaxy clusters found in the Dark Energy Survey utilizing Hubble Space Telescope imaging for lens modeling, and complementary constraints from Chandra X-ray observations. All three clusters are relaxed and have giant arc or ring lens structures ideal for constraints on the dark matter distribution. The strong lens modeling and X-ray temperatures yield consistent total cluster mass estimates. We find these clusters have best-fit X-ray temperatures of $2.7 - 6.2$ keV and total masses of M$_{200} = (1-6) \times 10^{14} M_{\odot}$. Our lens models parameterize dark matter distribution with a generalized Navarro-Frenk-White (GNFW) density profile. While the GNFW profile allows the inner dark matter slope to vary, we find in all cases that the inner slopes are consistent with the standard NFW density profile $γ^{DM} = 1$. The X-ray surface brightness distributions for all three clusters are generally symmetric with no significant substructure, supporting the conclusion that these are relaxed clusters. In addition, we find generally low values of the external shear magnitude with median values ranging $|γ^{ext}| = 0.04-0.09$ and consistent with zero for two of the clusters.

artifacts.abstract_zh: 我们利用哈勃空间望远镜成像进行透镜建模，并结合钱德拉X射线观测的补充约束，对暗能量巡天中发现的三颗强透镜星系团进行了质量建模。这三颗星系团均处于弛豫状态，并具有巨弧或环状透镜结构，非常适合用于约束暗物质分布。强透镜建模与X射线温度给出的星系团总质量估计一致。我们发现这些星系团的最佳拟合X射线温度为 $2.7 - 6.2$ keV，总质量为 M$_{200} = (1-6) \times 10^{14} M_{\odot}$。我们的透镜模型用广义Navarro-Frenk-White（GNFW）密度剖面参数化暗物质分布。虽然GNFW剖面允许内区暗物质斜率变化，但我们发现所有情况下内区斜率均与标准NFW密度剖面 $γ^{DM} = 1$ 一致。三颗星系团的X射线表面亮度分布总体对称，没有显著子结构，支持它们是弛豫星系团的结论。此外，我们发现外部剪切幅度普遍较低，中值为 $|γ^{ext}| = 0.04-0.09$，其中两颗星系团与零一致。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于现有摘要的AI结论：强透镜与X射线联合分析表明，这三个弛豫星系团的暗物质内区分布符合标准NFW剖面，外部剪切影响较弱，支持将此类巨弧星系团作为暗物质分布研究的理想探针。

title: SN Ares: A Strongly Lensed Type IIb Supernova at $\mathbf{z=1.276}$ with a Predicted 70-Year Time Delay
comment: 22 pages, 12 figures, 4 tables, submitted to ApJ
summary: We present the discovery of supernova (SN) Ares, a strongly lensed supernova at $z_{\rm spec}=1.276\pm0.002$ in a massive, triply imaged host galaxy behind the MACS J0308.9+2645 galaxy cluster. JWST/NIRSpec spectroscopy spanning the rest-frame optical to NIR of Ares reveals helium features at $5876\,\mathring{\mathrm{A}}$, $7065\,\mathring{\mathrm{A}}$, and $10830\,\mathring{\mathrm{A}}$, as well as H$α$ and Pa$β$. A comparison to local core-collapse SN spectra and light curves leads to a classification of SN Ares as a Type IIb supernova, the highest-redshift member of its class spectroscopically identified. A comparison to local SN IIb light curves provides a phase estimate for the spectrum of $34_{-9}^{+10}$ rest-frame days post-radioactive peak, providing a unique view into a high-redshift stripped-envelope supernova in its late-photospheric evolution. A lens model of the cluster constructed using recent JWST data indicates that SN Ares is the first image to arrive and will reappear in two future images near the center of the cluster plane in $\gtrsim 70$ years, with predicted magnifications of $\sim5\times$ and $\sim1.5\times$. Planned JWST/NIRSpec Multi-Object Spectroscopy of the cluster will allow for more detailed modeling of the lensed system for tighter constraints on the time delay and magnifications, as well as a template spectrum at the location of SN Ares.

title: Semi-Analytic Predictions for Strong-Lensing Perturbers in Cold and Self-Interacting Dark Matter
summary: Strong gravitational lensing is sensitive to the abundance and internal structure of dark matter halos, providing a probe of gravothermal evolution in self-interacting dark matter (SIDM). We combine semi-analytic cold dark matter (CDM) subhalo histories with a model for gravothermal evolution in SIDM to generate CDM and SIDM subhalo populations across SIDM parameter space. We predict their projected enclosed masses and deflection-based projected density slopes and compare them with three perturbers inferred through gravitational imaging in PJ011646, SDSS J0946+1006, and JVAS B1938+666. For SIDM model parameters $σ_0/m_χ=147.1$ cm$^2$/g and $w=120$ km/s, SIDM subhalos reproduce all three perturbers more often than CDM subhalos. For PJ011646, we find ~0.6 cored SIDM subhalos per host matching the perturber, compared with ~0.002 in CDM, while core-collapsed subhalos are too steep. For SDSS J0946+1006, we find ~3 core-collapsed and ~0.004 cored SIDM subhalos per host, compared with none in 900 CDM realizations, although baryons, neglected here, may matter for such massive subhalos. For "detection V" in JVAS B1938+666, we find ~220 core-collapsed and ~20 cored SIDM subhalos per host within the $2σ$ posterior region, compared with ~0.2 in CDM; the CDM candidates require exceptionally early accretion, at median redshift $z\sim13$. Simultaneously reproducing all three perturbers requires $w\gtrsim10^2$ km/s, so that the massive (~$5.6\times10^{10}M_\odot$) progenitors of SDSS J0946+1006 candidates can collapse, and is achieved for $σ_0/m_χ\gtrsim10^2$ cm$^2$/g in the parameter sets studied. Our results show how semi-analytic models can quantify how often subhalos reproduce individual perturbers in different dark matter models, and our modular framework can be readily updated as models of tidal stripping and late-stage gravothermal evolution in SIDM improve. title: Neglecting Dynamical Microlensing Can Bias Accretion Disk Size Measurements at the Population Level
summary: Microlensing of strongly lensed quasars probes unresolved accretion disks, but many inference methods use static magnification maps with fixed relative microlens positions. Using the GPU-accelerated simulator Microcaustics, we generate ten-year multiband light curves for three quadruply lensed quasar configurations. We compare dynamical microlensing with independent microlens motions against coherent bulk motion, and a microlens mass distribution against equal masses, keeping the velocity distribution of individual microlenses and mean mass fixed. We infer population disk sizes using ridge regression on the means and lower and upper scatters of ten variability and event metrics. We measure biases by applying models trained with simplified physics to simulations including both effects. Models trained on coherent motion interpret the additional variability from evolving caustics as smaller disks. For populations of 128 independent realizations, jointly inferred radii are consistently smaller by 6-28%. Microlens dynamics increase caustic-crossing rates pooled across all four macroimages by 5-15% and r-band high-magnification-event (HME) rates by 13-25%, while shortening median HME durations by 4-12%. Omitting the mass distribution produces configuration-dependent disk-size offsets from -12% to +5%. Including the mass distribution decreases caustic-crossing rates by 6-8% and HME rates by 6-12%. It also narrows the spread of ten-year averaged microlensing time-delay differences between macroimages by a median of 9-12% per system, while microlens dynamics have a smaller, image-pair-dependent effect. These results demonstrate the importance of microlens dynamics for population disk-size inference and motivate simulations that include dynamical microlensing and a microlens mass distribution.

AI.tldr: 基于GPU加速模拟器Microcaustics生成三个四重透镜类星体的十年多波段光变曲线，系统比较动态微引力透镜效应（独立微引力透镜运动 vs. 相干整体运动）与微引力透镜质量分布对吸积盘尺寸推断及焦散统计的影响，揭示简化物理模型带来的系统性偏差。
AI.motivation: 强透镜类星体的微引力透镜可探测未分辨的吸积盘，但许多推断方法使用静态放大率图并固定微引力透镜相对位置，忽略了微引力透镜运动和微引力透镜质量分布等真实物理效应，可能造成盘尺寸估计的系统偏差，需量化这些偏差。
AI.method: 使用GPU加速的Microcaustics模拟器，为三个四重透镜类星体构型生成十年多波段光变曲线；对比动态微引力透镜（独立运动）与相干整体运动，以及在保持单个微引力透镜速度分布和平均质量不变时，质量分布与等质量情形。对十项变异性与事件指标的均值及上下散射用岭回归推断群体盘尺寸，并用仅含简化物理训练的模型去拟合同时包含两种效应的模拟，测量偏差。
AI.result: 在相干运动上训练的模型将演化焦散带来的额外变异性误读为更小的盘：128个独立实现的群体联合推断半径系统性偏小6–28%。微引力透镜动力学使四个宏像汇总的焦散穿越率提高5–15%，r波段高放大事件（HME）率提高13–25%，同时使HME中位持续时间缩短4–12%。忽略质量分布导致盘尺寸偏移随构型在−12%至+5%之间。纳入质量分布使焦散穿越率下降6–8%、HME率下降6–12%，并使宏像间十年平均微引力透镜时延差的离散度中位数收窄9–12%，而微引力透镜动力学的影响较小且依赖像对。
AI.conclusion: 微引力透镜动力学对群体盘尺寸推断具有重要影响，简化物理会引入显著系统偏差；未来模拟应同时包含动态微引力透镜与微引力透镜质量分布，以保证盘尺寸推断的可靠性。

recommendation.reason: 论文聚焦强透镜类星体的微引力透镜效应及其对吸积盘尺寸推断的系统偏差，属于强引力透镜核心范畴，与用户强透镜主线高度契合；但研究对象为类星体吸积盘而非高红移星系动力学/多相气体，方法为模拟与统计推断，与用户偏好的高红移星系观测分析略有距离。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 强透镜类星体的微引力透镜效应可探测未分辨的吸积盘，但许多推断方法使用固定相对微引力透镜位置的静态放大率图。利用GPU加速模拟器Microcaustics，我们为三个四重透镜类星体构型生成了十年多波段光变曲线。我们将具有独立微引力透镜运动的动态微引力透镜与相干整体运动进行对比，并将微引力透镜质量分布与等质量情况进行对比，同时保持单个微引力透镜的速度分布和平均质量固定。我们使用对十个变异性与事件度量的均值及上下散布进行岭回归来推断群体盘尺寸。通过将用简化物理训练的模型应用于包含两种效应的模拟，我们测量了偏差。在相干运动上训练的模型将来自演化焦散的额外变异性解释为更小的盘。对于128个独立实现的群体，联合推断的半径一致偏小6-28%。微引力透镜动力学使所有四个宏观像汇总的焦散穿越率增加5-15%，r波段高放大率事件（HME）率增加13-25%，同时将HME持续时间中位数缩短4-12%。忽略质量分布会产生依赖于构型的盘尺寸偏移，从-12%到+5%。包含质量分布使焦散穿越率降低6-8%，HME率降低6-12%。它还将宏观像之间十年平均微引力透镜时间延迟差异的散布按系统中位数缩小9-12%，而微引力透镜动力学的影响较小且依赖于像对。这些结果证明了微引力透镜动力学对群体盘尺寸推断的重要性，并推动包含动态微引力透镜和微引力透镜质量分布的模拟。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于可用摘要：微引力透镜动力学对群体盘尺寸推断具有重要影响，简化物理会引入显著系统偏差；未来模拟应同时包含动态微引力透镜与微引力透镜质量分布，以保证盘尺寸推断的可靠性。

title: Multiphase Gas Structure in JWST Little Red Dots
summary: JWST has uncovered a population of compact high-redshift galaxies, 'little red dots' (LRDs), exhibiting broad Balmer emission lines that often show narrow absorption features and strong Balmer breaks - spectral signatures attributed to dense gas surrounding rapidly growing black holes, but whose small-scale structure remains unknown. A striking feature of LRD spectra is that the H$β$ absorption is systematically deeper than H$α$, yet in any homogeneous gas this ordering is physically impossible. Here we model the H$α$ and H$β$ line profiles using radiative transfer simulations for 11 LRDs with JWST sensitive high resolution spectroscopy, and independently constrain the $n=2$ hydrogen column density, $N_{\rm HI,\mathit{n}=2}$, from the Balmer-break continuum. We find that the $N_{\rm HI,\mathit{n}=2}$ from H$α$ in a homogeneous medium cannot reproduce the observed H$β$ absorption in several objects, and that this $N_{\rm HI,\mathit{n}=2}$ typically falls two orders of magnitude below the lower bound set by the Balmer break. Both tensions are simultaneously resolved by a multiphase medium of dense clumps within diffuse hot ionized gas. This multiphase gas structure is a necessary ingredient for any viable LRD model, regardless of the nature of the central engine.

artifacts.abstract_zh: JWST发现了一类紧凑的高红移星系——‘小红点’（LRDs），它们表现出宽的巴耳末发射线，这些发射线常伴有窄吸收特征和强巴耳末断裂——这些光谱特征被归因于围绕快速成长黑洞的致密气体，但其小尺度结构仍未知。LRD光谱的一个显著特征是H$\beta$吸收系统性地比H$\alpha$更深，然而在任何均匀气体中这种顺序在物理上是不可能的。在此，我们利用辐射转移模拟对11个具有JWST高灵敏度高分辨率光谱的LRD的H$\alpha$和H$\beta$线轮廓进行建模，并从巴耳末断裂连续谱独立约束$n=2$氢柱密度$N_{\rm HI,\mathit{n}=2}$。我们发现，在均匀介质中由H$\alpha$得到的$N_{\rm HI,\mathit{n}=2}$无法再现几个天体观测到的H$\beta$吸收，并且该$N_{\rm HI,\mathit{n}=2}$通常比巴耳末断裂设定的下限低两个数量级。这两个矛盾同时被一种由弥散热电离气体中致密团块组成的多相介质所解决。无论中心引擎的性质如何，这种多相气体结构都是任何可行LRD模型的必要成分。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 上述两个矛盾可同时由“致密团块嵌入弥散热电离气体”的多相介质解释。无论中心引擎本质如何，这种多相气体结构都是任何可行LRD模型的必要成分。

title: How Steep is your Dust? Direct Measurements of Nebular Attenuation Curves at Cosmic Noon with JWST
comment: 17 pages, 13 figures (+Appendix 3 pages, 6 figures), submitted to MNRAS, comments welcome
summary: Tracing the shape of the nebular attenuation curve, which is crucial for accurately measuring intrinsic emission-line fluxes, has proven challenging both in the local universe and at high redshift. Here we present nebular dust attenuation curves measured directly for 24 star-forming galaxies ($9.3<\log(\rm M{\star}/M_\odot)<11.1$) at cosmic noon ($1.8<z<3.3$) from the Blue Jay survey. Using deep JWST/NIRSpec spectra, we measure up to eight hydrogen recombination lines from H$δ$ to Pa$β$ per galaxy and find little diversity in the curve shape, with most galaxies agreeing with the \citet{calzetti_dust_2000} attenuation curve. For over $90\%$ of the sample, the nebular reddening from the Balmer lines is consistent with that from the Paschen lines. Using \texttt{Prospector} spectral energy distribution (SED) fits, we obtain the stellar reddening and find that the difference between stellar and nebular reddening increases with stellar mass, and that each reddening measurement is independent of inclination, which disagrees with the two-component dust model. We then measure the impact of using the derived nebular attenuation curve or a literature curve when determining metallicity using the strong-line method, and find that for some diagnostics (e.g., S32, S3, S23, and S3O3), the difference can be as large as $5σ$. Caution is needed when using these diagnostics if the nebular attenuation curve cannot be directly measured, since the resulting uncertainty can exceed the measurement uncertainty on the emission-line fluxes even with high signal-to-noise Balmer decrement measurements. These results show that the shape of the nebular attenuation curve is poorly understood and that constraining it is important for reducing systematic uncertainty in galaxy measurements.

title: Optical-Infrared Extinction Variation in Nearby Molecular Clouds
summary: The dust extinction curve is an important probe of the properties of dust grains, particularly their size distribution. The properties of dust grains are expected to change significantly in dense molecular clouds due to shielding from interstellar radiation and increased frequency of grain-grain and grain-gas collisions. We measure the dust extinction curve shape parameter R(V) in 9 nearby, dense molecular clouds using data from the APOGEE spectroscopic survey, in combination with ten-band photometry from PS1, 2MASS, and WISE. We analyze the results to determine how the extinction curve varies in nearby molecular clouds. We find that most molecular clouds show a positive correlation between R(V) and E(B-V), but the strength of the correlation varies significantly between clouds. In addition, we find that the clouds with the strongest correlation tend to have very high dispersion in R(V) at fixed E(B-V), which tightens dramatically when clouds are subdivided into separate regions. This suggests that local environmental conditions beyond density shape the R(V)-E(B-V) relation.

AI.tldr: 利用APOGEE光谱与PS1、2MASS、WISE十波段测光，测量9个近邻致密分子云的消光曲线形状参数R(V)，发现大多数云中R(V)与E(B-V)呈正相关但强度差异显著，且相关性最强的云在固定E(B-V)下R(V)弥散最大、细分区域后弥散显著收窄。
AI.motivation: 尘埃消光曲线是探测尘埃颗粒性质（尤其是粒径分布）的重要探针。在致密分子云中，由于星际辐射被屏蔽以及颗粒-颗粒、颗粒-气体碰撞频率增加，尘埃颗粒性质预期会发生显著变化，因此需要系统测量近邻分子云中消光曲线形状如何变化。
AI.method: 使用APOGEE光谱巡天数据，结合PS1、2MASS和WISE的十波段测光，对9个近邻致密分子云测量消光曲线形状参数R(V)，并分析R(V)与E(B-V)的关系及其在不同云之间和云内部的变化。
AI.result: 大多数分子云显示R(V)与E(B-V)呈正相关，但相关强度在云与云之间差异很大。相关性最强的云在固定E(B-V)下R(V)弥散非常高；将云细分为若干独立区域后，该弥散显著减小。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，除密度之外的局部环境条件也在塑造R(V)-E(B-V)关系，云内部的局部环境差异是导致R(V)弥散的重要来源。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 尘埃消光曲线是探测尘埃颗粒性质（尤其是其尺寸分布）的重要工具。由于致密分子云中星际辐射的屏蔽以及颗粒-颗粒和颗粒-气体碰撞频率的增加，尘埃颗粒的性质预计会发生显著变化。我们利用APOGEE光谱巡天数据，结合PS1、2MASS和WISE的十波段测光数据，测量了9个邻近致密分子云中的尘埃消光曲线形状参数R(V)。我们分析结果以确定邻近分子云中消光曲线的变化方式。我们发现大多数分子云在R(V)和E(B-V)之间表现出正相关，但相关强度在云之间差异显著。此外，我们发现相关性最强的云在固定E(B-V)下R(V)的弥散非常大，而当云被细分为不同区域时，这种弥散急剧减小。这表明除密度之外的局部环境条件塑造了R(V)-E(B-V)关系。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于现有摘要，结果表明除密度之外的局部环境条件也在塑造R(V)-E(B-V)关系，云内部的局部环境差异是导致R(V)弥散的重要来源。

title: The H IX galaxy survey IV: What does the molecular gas reveal in HI eXtreme galaxies
summary: Galaxies with extreme amounts of neutral atomic hydrogen (HI), known as HI-eXtreme (HIX) galaxies, paradoxically exhibit normal or low star formation rates. To investigate the bottleneck in their star formation, we present ALMA CO(1-0) observations for five HIX survey galaxies: ESO208-G026, ESO378-G003, ESO381-G005, ESO417-G018, and ESO055-G013. While these systems possess massive, extended HI discs, their molecular gas discs are compact with normal H$_{2}$ masses relative to their stellar mass. Dynamical modelling with 3DBarolo reveals that the HI and molecular gas are kinematically consistent. Both gas phases show high velocity dispersions, indicating enhanced turbulence compared to regular late-type galaxies. We calculate the specific angular momentum for the stellar, atomic, and molecular components alongside the global stability parameter ($q$). Most of the system angular momentum is stored in the HI discs, rendering them globally stable against collapse. This stability suppresses the atomic-to-molecular gas conversion, as evidenced by extremely long HI depletion times contrasted with typical H$_{2}$ depletion times. The high angular momentum and HI excess likely originate from past gas accretion or recent tidal interactions; this is especially apparent in ESO378-G003 and ESO381-G005, which exhibit extended HI structures and positive tidal indices.

AI.tldr: 对五个HI-eXtreme星系开展ALMA CO(1-0)观测与3DBarolo动力学建模，发现其分子气体盘致密但质量正常，系统角动量主要存储于HI盘使其全局稳定，从而抑制原子到分子气体的转换，导致极长的HI耗尽时标。
AI.motivation: HIX星系拥有极端数量的中性原子氢却表现出正常甚至偏低的恒星形成率，这一悖论背后的恒星形成瓶颈机制尚不清楚，需要考察其分子气体含量、动力学状态与稳定性。
AI.method: 对ESO208-G026、ESO378-G003、ESO381-G005、ESO417-G018、ESO055-G013五个HIX巡天星系进行ALMA CO(1-0)观测；用3DBarolo进行动力学建模比较HI与分子气体的运动学一致性；计算恒星、原子、分子各组分的比角动量及全局稳定性参数q，并结合HI与H2耗尽时标和潮汐指数分析。
AI.result: 这些星系虽有巨大而延展的HI盘，但分子气体盘致密，H2质量相对恒星质量属正常水平；HI与分子气体运动学一致，两者速度弥散均偏高，显示比常规晚型星系更强的湍流；系统大部分角动量存于HI盘，使其全局稳定、难以坍缩，原子到分子气体转换被抑制，表现为极长的HI耗尽时标与典型的H2耗尽时标；ESO378-G003和ESO381-G005呈现延展HI结构和正潮汐指数。
AI.conclusion: HIX星系恒星形成受抑的主因是HI盘承载的高角动量带来的全局稳定性，而非分子气体匮乏；高角动量和HI过剩可能源于过去的 gas accretion 或近期潮汐相互作用。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 拥有极端量中性原子氢（HI）的星系，被称为HI极端（HIX）星系，却矛盾地表现出正常或较低的恒星形成率。为了探究其恒星形成过程中的瓶颈，我们对五个HIX巡天星系：ESO208-G026、ESO378-G003、ESO381-G005、ESO417-G018和ESO055-G013，进行了ALMA CO(1-0)观测。尽管这些系统拥有巨大且延展的HI盘，它们的分子气体盘却较为致密，且相对于其恒星质量具有正常的H$_{2}$质量。利用3DBarolo进行的动力学建模显示，HI和分子气体在运动学上是一致的。两种气体相都表现出高速度弥散，表明与常规晚型星系相比，其湍流增强。我们计算了恒星、原子和分子组分的比角动量以及全局稳定性参数（$q$）。系统的大部分角动量储存在HI盘中，使其在整体上对坍缩是稳定的。这种稳定性抑制了原子到分子气体的转换，这由极长的HI耗尽时间与典型的H$_{2}$耗尽时间形成对比所证明。高角动量和HI过剩可能源于过去的气体吸积或近期的潮汐相互作用；这在ESO378-G003和ESO381-G005中尤为明显，它们表现出延展的HI结构和正的潮汐指数。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于可用摘要：HIX星系恒星形成受抑的主因是HI盘承载的高角动量带来的全局稳定性，而非分子气体匮乏；高角动量和HI过剩可能源于过去的气体吸积或近期潮汐相互作用。

title: Unveiling the correlation between the UV 2175 Å dust attenuation bump, PAH emission, and gas-phase metallicity at cosmic noon

summary: The UV 2175 Å attenuation bump is one of the most prominent yet poorly understood features of galaxy attenuation curves. Its main candidate carrier is polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon (PAH) molecules, which are more prevalent in high-metallicity environments. We present the first systematic study of the relationship between PAH abundance and the UV bump in 49 galaxies at cosmic noon (1.5 < z < 2.7), examining its dependence on stellar mass, star formation rate (SFR), and V-band optical depth. For 19 galaxies, we also investigate gas-phase metallicity using oxygen abundances. We measure the bump amplitude from VLT/MUSE spectroscopy and derive galaxy properties, including the PAH-to-dust mass fraction $q_{\rm PAH}$, through spectral energy distribution fitting with Prospector, combining JWST/NIRCam and JWST/MIRI photometry. Oxygen abundances are derived from strong-line diagnostics using Keck/MOSFIRE and JWST/NIRSpec data. We find a positive correlation between bump amplitude $E_{\rm bump}$ and $q_{\rm PAH}$ (Spearman $ρ= 0.60$). UV bumps are rarely detected at low $q_{\rm PAH}$, supporting PAHs as their primary carriers. Both $E_{\rm bump}$ and $q_{\rm PAH}$ correlate with stellar mass, oxygen abundance, and optical depth, and anticorrelate with specific SFR, suggesting that PAHs and the UV bump are suppressed in low-metallicity, dust-poor, and/or intensely star-forming environments. This is consistent with PAH destruction in environments with limited dust shielding and/or strong radiation fields. A principal component analysis of $E_{\rm bump}$, $q_{\rm PAH}$, optical depth, specific SFR, and oxygen abundance explains 97% of the variance, suggesting that previously reported correlations with stellar mass reflect an underlying dependence on metallicity. Finally, variations in dust geometry may explain the wide range of bump amplitudes (0-0.5 mag) at high $q_{\rm PAH}$.

AI.tldr: 研究49个宇宙正午星系，首次系统证实UV 2175Å吸收凸起幅度与PAH质量分数正相关，并表明恒星质量相关性实为金属丰度依赖。
AI.motivation: 2175Å紫外衰减凸起是星系衰减曲线中最显著却最缺乏理解的特征之一，其主要候选载体PAH分子在高金属丰度环境中更普遍，但此前缺乏对PAH丰度与凸起关系在宇宙正午时期的系统观测检验。
AI.method: 对1.5<z<2.7的49个星系，用VLT/MUSE光谱测量凸起幅度E_bump；用Prospector结合JWST/NIRCam与MIRI测光做SED拟合，得到PAH-尘埃质量比q_PAH；对其中19个星系，用Keck/MOSFIRE与JWST/NIRSpec强线诊断求气相氧丰度；并用主成分分析考察E_bump、q_PAH、光学深度、sSFR与氧丰度的关系。
AI.result: E_bump与q_PAH呈正相关（Spearman ρ=0.60），低q_PAH处几乎探测不到UV凸起；E_bump与q_PAH均与恒星质量、氧丰度、光学深度正相关，与sSFR反相关。主成分分析解释97%的方差，表明此前报道的与恒星质量的相关性反映的是金属丰度这一潜在依赖。
AI.conclusion: PAH是UV凸起的主要载体，PAH与凸起在低金属丰度、贫尘埃和/或强恒星形成环境中被抑制，符合有限尘埃屏蔽或强辐射场下PAH被破坏的图像；在高q_PAH处凸起幅度仍跨越0–0.5 mag的宽范围，可能由尘埃几何差异所致。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 紫外2175 Å衰减凸起是星系衰减曲线中最显著但理解最少的特征之一。其主要候选载体是多环芳烃（PAH）分子，这类分子在高金属丰度环境中更为普遍。我们首次对宇宙正午（1.5 < z < 2.7）49个星系中PAH丰度与紫外凸起之间的关系进行了系统研究，考察了其对恒星质量、恒星形成率（SFR）和V波段光学深度的依赖性。对于其中19个星系，我们还利用氧丰度研究了气相金属丰度。我们从VLT/MUSE光谱测量凸起幅度，并通过Prospector结合JWST/NIRCam和JWST/MIRI测光进行光谱能量分布拟合，推导星系性质，包括PAH与尘埃质量比 $q_{\rm PAH}$。氧丰度利用Keck/MOSFIRE和JWST/NIRSpec数据通过强线诊断得到。我们发现凸起幅度 $E_{\rm bump}$ 与 $q_{\rm PAH}$ 之间存在正相关（Spearman $ρ= 0.60$）。在低 $q_{\rm PAH}$ 下很少探测到紫外凸起，支持PAH作为其主要载体。$E_{\rm bump}$ 和 $q_{\rm PAH}$ 均与恒星质量、氧丰度和光学深度相关，并与比恒星形成率反相关，表明PAH和紫外凸起在低金属丰度、贫尘埃和/或强恒星形成环境中受到抑制。这与在有限尘埃屏蔽和/或强辐射场环境中PAH被破坏的图像一致。对 $E_{\rm bump}$、$q_{\rm PAH}$、光学深度、比恒星形成率和氧丰度进行主成分分析可解释97%的方差，表明先前报道的与恒星质量的相关性反映了对金属丰度的潜在依赖。最后，尘埃几何的变化可能解释在高 $q_{\rm PAH}$ 下凸起幅度的宽范围（0-0.5 mag）。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于现有摘要：PAH是紫外凸起的主要载体，PAH与凸起在低金属丰度、贫尘埃和/或强恒星形成环境中被抑制，符合有限尘埃屏蔽或强辐射场下PAH被破坏的图像；在高 $q_{\rm PAH}$ 处凸起幅度仍跨越0–0.5 mag的宽范围，可能由尘埃几何差异所致。

figures.caption_en: Figure 2 : Distributions of \(q_{PAH}\) (left), stellar mass (center left), SFR (center right), and spectroscopic redshift (right) for the parent sample (120 galaxies, gray), the final sample (49 galaxies, blue), and the metallicity subsample (19 galaxies, orange), defined by the criteria in Sect. 2.4 . The dashed vertical lines indicate the median values per sample/subsample. The differences in the stellar mass and SFR distributions between the parent sample (gray) and the final sample (blue), visible as a lack of low-mass galaxies in the final sample, arise from the selection step in which we removed galaxies with fewer than two detections ( \(>3\sigma\) ) in MIRI filters longward of F1280W.
figures.caption_zh: 图2：母样本（120个星系，灰色）、最终样本（49个星系，蓝色）和金属丰度子样本（19个星系，橙色）的 $q_{PAH}$（左）、恒星质量（中左）、SFR（中右）和光谱红移（右）分布，样本由第2.4节中的标准定义。虚线竖线表示各样本/子样本的中值。母样本（灰色）与最终样本（蓝色）在恒星质量和SFR分布上的差异（表现为最终样本中缺乏低质量星系）源于我们剔除在F1280W以长MIRI滤光片中探测数少于两个（ $>3\sigma$ ）的星系这一筛选步骤。

figures.caption_en: Figure 4 : 2175 Å UV attenuation bump amplitude ( \(E_{bump}\) ) as a function of the PAH-to-total dust mass fraction ( \(q_{PAH}\) ). Points are color-coded by stellar mass (left; 49 galaxies) and oxygen abundance (right; 19 galaxies). AGN are shown as stars and are included in the analysis. In the right panel, gray points indicate galaxies without metallicity measurements and are shown for reference only. Squares show medians and standard deviations for subsamples built according to mass and metallicity, as shown in the legend and Tab. 1 . We fit the data points with a weighted quadratic model of the form \(ax^{2}+bx+c\) , shown as red dashed lines; the coefficients are \(a=(6.11\pm 7.99)\times 10^{-3}\) , \(b=(2.14\pm 4.11)\times 10^{-2}\) , and \(c=(2.55\pm 43.58)\times 10^{-3}\) for the final sample (left panel) and \(a=(7.91\pm 12.31)\times 10^{-3}\) , \(b=(1.31\pm 6.74)\times 10^{-2}\) , and \(c=(1.16\pm 7.60)\times 10^{-2}\) for the metallicity subsample (right panel). The grey vertical and horizontal lines represent the error bars on the data points in the y and x variables, respectively. Spearman rank correlation coefficient and corresponding \(p-\) values between \(E_{bump}\) and \(q_{PAH}\) are reported in each panel. Overall, the figure shows a clear positive correlation between \(E_{bump}\) and \(q_{PAH}\) , with a possible non-linear trend at high \(q_{PAH}\) .
figures.caption_zh: 图4：2175 Å紫外衰减凸起幅度（ $E_{bump}$ ）作为PAH与总尘埃质量比（ $q_{PAH}$ ）的函数。数据点按恒星质量（左；49个星系）和氧丰度（右；19个星系）着色。AGN以星形表示并纳入分析。右图中，灰色点表示没有金属丰度测量的星系，仅作参考。方块表示按质量和金属丰度构建的子样本的中值和标准差，如 legend 和表1所示。我们用形式为 $ax^{2}+bx+c$ 的加权二次模型拟合数据点，以红色虚线表示；最终样本（左图）的系数为 $a=(6.11\pm 7.99)\times 10^{-3}$、$b=(2.14\pm 4.11)\times 10^{-2}$ 和 $c=(2.55\pm 43.58)\times 10^{-3}$，金属丰度子样本（右图）的系数为 $a=(7.91\pm 12.31)\times 10^{-3}$、$b=(1.31\pm 6.74)\times 10^{-2}$ 和 $c=(1.16\pm 7.60)\times 10^{-2}$。灰色竖线和横线分别表示数据点在y和x变量上的误差棒。每个面板中报告了 $E_{bump}$ 与 $q_{PAH}$ 之间的Spearman秩相关系数及相应的 $p-$ 值。总体而言，该图显示 $E_{bump}$ 与 $q_{PAH}$ 之间存在明显的正相关，在高 $q_{PAH}$ 处可能存在非线性趋势。

figures.caption_en: Figure 5 : Diagram illustrating two different scenarios that could explain the variation in \(E_{bump}\) at high \(q_{PAH}\) . In the first scenario, the young stellar population is obscured by a uniform dust screen; in this case, galaxies with high PAH abundances will exhibit strong UV bumps and high optical depths. In the second scenario, clumpy dust geometry gives rise to both obscured and unobscured young stellar populations. The UV-optical emission is dominated by the unobscured component, resulting in weak or absent bumps and low \(\tau_{V}\) . In contrast, the mid-IR emission, which traces PAHs, is dominated by the dusty regions, leading to high PAH abundances.
figures.caption_zh: 图5：示意图说明两种可解释高 $q_{PAH}$ 下 $E_{bump}$ 变化的场景。在第一种场景中，年轻星族被均匀尘埃屏遮蔽；此时，PAH丰度高的星系将表现出强紫外凸起和高光学深度。在第二种场景中，团块状尘埃几何同时产生被遮蔽和未被遮蔽的年轻星族。紫外-光学辐射由未被遮蔽成分主导，导致凸起微弱或缺失以及低 $\tau_{V}$。相反，追踪PAH的中红外辐射由尘埃区域主导，导致高PAH丰度。

figures.caption_en: Table 1 : Median values of \(E_{bump}\) , \(q_{PAH}\) , stellar mass, and oxygen abundance in stellar mass and metallicity bins (Fig. 4 ).
figures.caption_zh: 表1：在恒星质量和金属丰度分箱中 $E_{bump}$、$q_{PAH}$、恒星质量和氧丰度的中值（图4）。

figures.caption_en: Figure 6 : Comparison between measured \(E_{bump}\) and values reconstructed from the PCA-derived relation for the metallicity subsample (Eq. 2 ) using \(E_{bump}\) , \(q_{PAH}\) , \(12+\log_{10}({O/H})\) , sSFR, and \(\tau_{V}\) , obtained by setting PC5 (accounting for \(\sim 3\%\) of the total variance) to zero. Although PCA was performed on standardized variables, the resulting relation is represented in physical units for clarity, following Eq. 2 . The grey vertical and horizontal lines represent the error bars on the data points in the y and x variables, respectively. Overall, the PCA-derived \(E_{bump}\) shows good agreement with the measured values, supporting the validity of the inferred multivariate relation.
figures.caption_zh: 图6：金属丰度子样本中测量的 $E_{bump}$ 与利用 $E_{bump}$、$q_{PAH}$、$12+\log_{10}({O/H})$、sSFR和 $\tau_{V}$ 通过PCA导出关系（式2）重建的值之间的比较，重建时将PC5（占总方差的 $\sim 3\%$）设为零。尽管PCA是在标准化变量上进行的，但为清晰起见，所得关系按式2以物理单位表示。灰色竖线和横线分别表示数据点在y和x变量上的误差棒。总体而言，PCA导出的 $E_{bump}$ 与测量值吻合良好，支持所推断多变量关系的有效性。

figures.caption_en: Figure 7 : 2175 Å UV attenuation bump amplitude ( \(E_{bump}\) ) as a function of PAH-to-total dust mass fraction ( \(q_{PAH}\) ), color-coded by dust optical depth (45 galaxies). The grey vertical and horizontal lines represent the error bars on the data points in the y and x variables, respectively. In the high- \(q_{PAH}\) regime ( \(q_{PAH}\geq 3\,\%\) ), the scatter in the bump amplitude appears to be driven by dust optical depth.
figures.caption_zh: 图7：2175 Å紫外衰减凸起幅度（ $E_{bump}$ ）作为PAH与总尘埃质量比（ $q_{PAH}$ ）的函数，按尘埃光学深度着色（45个星系）。灰色竖线和横线分别表示数据点在y和x变量上的误差棒。在高 $q_{PAH}$ 区域（ $q_{PAH}\geq 3\,\%$ ），凸起幅度的散布似乎由尘埃光学深度驱动。

figures.caption_en: Figure 8 : \(q_{PAH}\) as a function of various galaxy properties. AGN are included in the plots but not in the analysis. Top left: Stellar mass, including the median for cosmic noon ( \(z\sim 0.7-2.0\) ) galaxies from Shivaei et al. (2024) . Top center: Gas-phase metallicity, with the relation from Whitcomb et al. (2024) ( \(z\sim 0\) ), the solar metallicity value (cyan; Asplund et al. 2009 ), and the metallicity threshold inferred from the O3N2 ratio in Shivaei et al. (2017) ( \(z\sim 2\) ). Top right: Optical depth. Bottom left: Redshift. Bottom center: sSFR, including the corrected fits from Chastenet et al. (2024) ( \(z\sim 0\) ). The correction factor \(k=3.5\) is applied to the fit following the form \(y=ax+b+k\) , where \(y=q_{PAH}\penalty\ [\%]\) , \(x=\log_{10}(sSFR/yr^{-1})\) , and \(a=-2.58\) and \(b=-22.86\) are the coefficients given in Chastenet et al. (2024) . \(k\) lies within the uncertainties on \(b\) reported in that work. Bottom right: Offset from the star-forming main sequence, also compared to the relations from Chastenet et al. (2024) . Blue stars indicate AGN-host galaxies, and black dots SFGs. We report Spearman rank correlation coefficients and corresponding \(p-\) values for the sample of SFGs (excluding AGN) in each panel. Median values in bins of the \(x-\) axis variables are shown in pink, with a minimum bin size of nine sources for the final sample and six sources for the metallicity subsample (see Tab. 2 ). The solid pink lines show the best-fit relations for the SFG sample (see Tab. 2 for fitting coefficients). The grey vertical and horizontal lines represent the error bars on the data points in the y and x variables, respectively. The Spearman coefficients are largely consistent with the results obtained from the whole sample (SFGs+AGN; Fig. 3 ). Overall, PAH abundances are mostly correlated with stellar mass, gas-phase metallicity, dust optical depth, and sSFR.
